response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience as a Senior Software Developer with strong expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and other languages, but his recent roles have focused heavily on TypeScript and AI-agent infrastructure rather than Java. While he has some Java experience, it is not a recent focus, and his lack of German language proficiency (only basic) is a significant gap for the role, which requires strong German communication skills.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and frameworks
Strong background in agile methodologies, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship
Proven ability to work on complex projects and contribute to open-source platforms
concerns: Limited recent experience with Java, the core required language for the role
Lacks required German language proficiency (only basic)
Overqualified for an entry-level Junior Java Developer position due to senior-level experience
